explanation: This function is vulnerable to OS command injection (CWE-78) because user_input is concatenated directly into subprocess.run('ls ' + user_input, shell=True). Crafted input containing shell operators could execute arbitrary OS commands. The repair applies shlex.quote(user_input) while keeping shell=True, which protects POSIX shells but remains ineffective on non-POSIX shells such as Windows and allows flag injection into ls.
